metaDescription: Beagle vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Beagle boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Colostrum fade is the clock behind this Beagle table, and doses at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks exist to immunize the puppy while exposure (parks, foster homes, boarding intros) is rising.
Boarding desks ask for finished Beagle dates, not intentions, so a Beagle with only the first DA2PP / DHPP dose is still incomplete for most facilities.
Ear infections shows up often enough in Beagles that vaccine day is also screening day — keep both on the same visit when possible.
Store the rabies label with the Beagle profile immediately; lost paperwork is the most common reason Beagle travel and kennel check-ins stall.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Beagle shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or ear infections worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Beagle make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Beagle antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Beagle dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this small dog.
Reset the Beagle reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Beagle core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Beagle misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Beagle health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Beagle adult health guide for breed predispositions such as ear infections, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
